restrained-satire.voice_reason: Z, like the reference, lets judgment emerge from flat external detail and a repeated crowd chorus (有人回了鼓掌，有人回了拱手) with almost no narrator commentary, whereas X layers explanatory similes and closing aphorisms over the scene and pastes the reference's 『』 quotation marks as surface mimicry.
restrained-satire.notes: W, X and Y are near-identical variants of one text; Y vs W is nearly indistinguishable (Y drops the 怕吵醒什么 simile and one 任何), and X differs mainly by cutting the 钉鞋掌 coda and adding 『』 marks. W/X/Y also invent the letter's content (摊位费涨了两回) and have an internal day-count wobble (old man arrives 第三十天下午 yet the count reaches 三十一 that evening); not listed as violations since the task is fiction and does not forbid additions. V's afternoon timing is the same kind of 下班前 shift, but V otherwise keeps the deadpan, documentary register (供应商验收单, the 大妈 thanked after eleven seconds) that sits closest to the reference after Z. Z is the only draft keeping the 下班前 system selection intact.
